summary: Backend testing completed for Zoom Worker System ultra-optimized features. All 20 pytest cases passed against the external preview URL. Verified: admin auth + cookies, fleet-health endpoint structure + admin gate, worker create/heartbeat/list, claim/progress/complete e2e, greedy sequential RDP fill (1st worker gets full capacity, 2nd gets remainder), voluntary release-chunk decrementing members_claimed, auto-failover (poller releases chunks of stale workers within 15s and resets members_claimed), all 5 new worker file download endpoints, existing /tasks/{active,scheduled,previous} and /workers CRUD, DELETE /workers/{id}, POST /tasks/{id}/cancel, and graceful Redis cache path.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1974 lines — strongly consider splitting into modules (auth, workers, tasks, scheduler, downloads). Maintainability risk.
task_poller has no jitter/backoff and runs every 5s; under heavy load consider exponential backoff on consecutive errors (currently it logs and continues).

_create_worker DELETE flow in tests passes, but DELETE /workers/{id} does not appear to cascade-release the worker's active chunks (auto-failover only handles stale heartbeats). Admin-deleted busy workers could orphan chunks until the heartbeat goes stale — confirm or add explicit chunk-release on delete.
Hardcoded ROOT_DIR.parent / 'worker' coupling for download endpoints — if backend is relocated, breaks silently with 404. Consider configurable WORKER_DIR env var.

Login attempt rate-limiting is enabled (test_login_invalid passes on 401 or 429) but the test_credentials seed runs every startup — fine, but ensure password rotation via env doesn't break login_attempts tracking.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_worker_<uuid> workers and tasks with meeting_password='TESTPWD'; autouse fixture cleans them up before and after the session.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new endpoints (fleet-health, release-chunk, 5 worker downloads) plus the greedy distribution + stale-worker auto-failover are verified end-to-end. Use /app/backend/tests/test_zoom_optimizations.py as a regression suite. Redis is up (PONG) on localhost:6379; cache layer test is best-effort and tolerates redis being down.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in the requested feature set.
